text:
mia.design: Quick design check: iterating on the trace drilldown UI. Need opinions on exports, permalink affordance, and accessibility notes.
sam.support: Great timing. Support wants an easy CSV that auditors can open in Excel without weird column names.
leo.engineering: Implementation flags welcome. Large traces are common and we should avoid fetching everything by default.
anya.product: Goal: make traces easy to share with SRE and auditors while keeping the page snappy.
mia.design: Proposed actions: primary button reads `Save trace` with a dropdown: `CSV (all events) / CSV (errors only) / JSON`. Filenames: `trace-<id>-YYYYMMDD.csv`. Correlation ID displayed monospace, truncated in list as `abcd1…9f3`, hover shows full and both a copy icon and an external-link icon.
noah.a11y: Accessibility checklist: - Ensure dropdown is keyboard operable and ARIA labelled. - Copy toast uses `role=status`. - Full-stack modal must trap focus and have `aria-labelledby` and `aria-modal=true`. - Use visible focus outlines and 4.5:1 contrast for chips.
sam.support: For CSV headers, use human-readable titles: `Correlation ID, Service, Event, Latency (ms), Timestamp`. Avoid snake_case.
leo.engineering: Backend approach: lazy load full frames on `Open full trace` click. Add endpoint: `GET /api/traces/:id/export?format=csv&scope=all|errors`. Support streaming and `Range` for huge payloads. Example curl: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/api/traces/abcd1234/export?format=csv&scope=errors" -o trace-errors.csv
mia.design: UI microcopy: change page header to `Trace details` (helps avoid confusing with list view). Empty stack message: `No stack available for this event`. Inline show up to 4 frames with `Show X more frames` link that opens modal for full list.
noah.a11y: Announce frame counts: use `aria-live` region when the modal opens: "Showing 4 of 12 stack frames". Each frame should be a list item with position announced.
leo.engineering: UX/perf tradeoff: animate expand/collapse but keep under 120ms. Cap inline frames to 4, fetch remainder on demand. Add `Copy stack` quick action (copies plain text).
anya.product: Permalinks: open in a new tab and preserve filter params (env, time window). Small external link icon next to ID for that.
mia.design: Focus flow: first focusable control is copy ID, tab to open link, tab to save dropdown, then timeline. Provide keyboard shortcuts doc in footer: `P` to copy permalink, `S` to save/export.
ci-bot: Design spec uploaded to #design-reviews and Figma link: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/trace-drilldown
sam.support: One more ask: include a compact summary row at top: `Errors 2 • Avg latency 98ms • Services: auth, gateway` so support can triage before expanding.
leo.engineering: I'll draft the proto changes and add notes about streaming exports and rate limits.
mia.design: Will update Figma with modal and truncated ID hover states by EOD. Thanks all :raised_hands:
ci-bot: Reminder: run accessibility checks in CI on the trace page component.
